title: Nightscout uploader bug with multiple insulin profiles
symptom: In xDrip, the prediction line for Lantus shows 4-6 hours duration, but Lantus works for 24 hours. Additionally, when data is uploaded to Nightscout, basal Lantus doses appear as fast bolus insulin.
evidence_quote: prediction line for lantus has 4-6 hours for lantus, but it works all 24 hours. And then all data uploaded in my nightscout, and it shows basal lantus doses as fast bolus insuline.
